'''Hrvoje Kap''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1998 Toola Regional (Malmö)]] on 1998 with Hoth clouds starting on Do Or Do Not, according to Martin Akesson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1274">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-scandinavian-regional-98d1274/ scandinavian-regional-98], DeckTech (Martin "Mart" Akesson, 27 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-27-scandinavian-regional-98d1274/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
